description: TenantKeep Posture check catalog. One file per domain. Copyright (c) 2026 Kainor LLC; the catalog text, logic and framework mappings are the protected part of the product (LICENSE.md). domains: every domain in report order with its label; the report, the findings export and the public catalog page read it, so a new domain is data only. attack: the MITRE ATT&CK release the checks' technique ids are checked against; build.ps1 -Task AttackData writes checks/attack.json from that release and refuses any other. changes: one entry per catalog version whose checks changed meaning, with the checks that can move for a tenant that did not change and why; the trend reads it so a result that moved with the catalog is not called a new failure or a fix.

changes.summary: Twenty-six new checks, most from settings the run already collects and two from new reads on permissions already held, and the CISA SCuBA ids brought up to CISA's current baselines, which changes which checks the SCuBA baseline selects.

checks.PV-009: New: whether a label policy gives an email the sensitivity label of its attachment. Needs a Purview collection made with this version or later.
checks.ID-025: New: whether ordinary users may register applications.
checks.EM-029: New: sender domains on an anti-spam policy's allowed list.
checks.EM-030: New: Safe Links policies that check links before delivery, record clicks and allow no click-through.
checks.EM-031: New: the connection filter's safe list.
checks.EM-032: New: the safety tips of the anti-phishing policies.
checks.EM-033: New: sharing policies that give every outside domain contacts or calendar detail.
checks.CL-020: New: whether Teams channels accept email.
checks.CL-021: New: whether Anyone links can do more than view.
checks.CL-022: New: how soon a one-time code sign-in must be repeated. Needs a SharePoint collection made with this version or later.
checks.CL-023: New: whether outside participants may take control in a Teams meeting.
checks.CL-024: New: whether people who dial in skip the lobby.
checks.CL-025: New: whether SharePoint accepts legacy authentication.
checks.CL-026: New: whether guests may share items they do not own.
checks.PV-010: New: whether any enforced DLP policy has a rule that blocks.
checks.PV-011: New: whether a DLP policy that blocks tells the person why.
checks.PV-012: New: whether the six built-in alert policies for a hijacked mailbox or connector are on.
checks.PV-013: New: whether those alerts are emailed to anyone. Needs a Purview collection made with this version or later.
checks.CL-027: New: whether everyone may record Teams meetings.
checks.CL-028: New: whether live events are always recorded. Needs a Teams collection made with this version or later.
checks.CL-029: New: whether custom Teams apps are available to everyone by default.
checks.CA-017: New: whether a Conditional Access policy protects the registration of sign-in methods. The CISA SCuBA baseline counts only a policy that asks for a managed device.
checks.ID-026: New: whether anyone is alerted when a privileged role is assigned. Needs an Entra collection made with this version or later. The CISA SCuBA baseline counts only an address beyond the default recipients.
checks.ID-027: New: whether anyone is alerted when a privileged role is activated. Needs an Entra collection made with this version or later. The CISA SCuBA baseline counts only an address beyond the default recipients.
checks.ID-028: New: whether the tenant refuses new client secrets on applications. Needs an Entra collection made with this version or later.
checks.ID-029: New: whether application secrets and certificates have a maximum lifetime. Needs an Entra collection made with this version or later.

changes.summary: Four new checks from reads that each need a new read permission on the consent, and federation signing certificates on the expiry calendar.

checks.OP-006: The expiry calendar gains the token-signing certificate of each federated domain. Where one could not be read, a calendar with nothing near its date has no answer.
checks.OP-011: New: Message Center posts whose act-by date is inside the warning window.
checks.HY-034: New: open Defender for Identity health issues.
checks.DEV-025: New: whether an Intune multi-admin approval policy exists.
checks.DEV-026: New: Intune role assignments that give a writing role over every device and user.

changes.summary: Ten new checks from reads that need no new permission, and a longer expiry calendar.

checks.OP-006: The expiry calendar gains Apple Automated Device Enrollment tokens, trial subscriptions and subscriptions in their grace period, so it can list items it did not know about before.
checks.OP-009: New: Secure Score against its best day in the last 90.
checks.OP-010: New: subscriptions in their grace period, suspended or locked out.
checks.DEV-024: New: Intune certificate connectors that have stopped answering.
checks.ID-024: New: applications that hold Graph application permissions and have not signed in for 90 days.
checks.AZ-029: New: the share of evaluated resources that comply with Azure Policy.
checks.AZ-030: New: Azure Lighthouse delegations that give another tenant more than read access.
checks.EM-028: New: whether Exchange Online rejects Direct Send.
checks.CL-017: New: how long a deleted user's OneDrive is kept.
checks.CL-018: New: OneDrive sync limited to the organisation's own domain-joined computers (hybrid tenants).
checks.CL-019: New: idle browser sessions signed out of SharePoint and OneDrive.

changes.summary: A check has no answer where its data is missing or was read in part, instead of a pass or a fail. Administrators are counted as people: a role held through a group, or as eligible, counts. Affected counts above 500 are the true number.

checks.ID-001: Counts the people who hold Global Administrator, the members of a group that holds it included; a group used to count as one.
checks.ID-002: Counts permanent roles held through a group.
checks.ID-003: Counts synced accounts that hold a role through a group.
checks.ID-004: Counts licensed accounts that hold a role through a group.
checks.AU-008: Holds administrators who are only eligible, or who hold a role through a group, to a phishing-resistant method.
checks.EM-025: Everyone who holds a role counts as an administrator, and the number listed is the true count.
checks.AZ-003: Judges the subscriptions that were read in detail; one that was not read is no longer counted as a gap.
checks.AZ-005: Judges the subscriptions that were read in detail; one that was not read is no longer counted as a gap.
checks.AZ-006: Judges the subscriptions that were read in detail; one that was not read is no longer counted as a gap.
checks.AZ-017: Judges the subscriptions that were read in detail; one that was not read is no longer counted as a gap.
checks.AZ-023: Judges the subscriptions that were read in detail; one that was not read is no longer counted as a gap.
checks.AZ-025: Judges the subscriptions that were read in detail; one that was not read is no longer counted as a gap.
checks.DEV-019: The number affected is the true count; it used to stop at 500.
checks.DEV-020: The number affected is the true count; it used to stop at 500.
checks.DEV-021: The number affected is the true count; it used to stop at 500.
checks.DEV-023: The number affected is the true count; it used to stop at 500.
checks.UX-009: The number affected is the true count; it used to stop at 500.
checks.UX-010: The number affected is the true count; it used to stop at 500.
checks.HY-032: Counts every synced group that access depends on; the number used to stop at 500.
